meta.note: Poydevor tokenlari tokens.css dan (color-mix olinmagan). 2026-11-17: Liquid Glass poydevori (glass-*, btn-glass-*, floor-*-glow), 1-qavat nav-*, 2-qavat adm-* (2 va 5-rasm). Hali repoda yo'q. 2026-11-18: 5-qavat eyuf-* (zumrad/oltin, Playfair Display). 2026-11-18 (yakun): ishlatilmagan serif (Source Serif 4) oilasi olindi; Sora bundle.css @import ga qo'shildi.

tokens.name: glass-bg
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass sirti: karta, panel, tab, input. Doim `glass-blur` bilan. Ostida rangli fon bo'lishi kerak; matn ko'p bo'lsa `glass-bg-strong`.

tokens.name: btn-glass-bg
tokens.usage: Asosiy kapsula tugma: to'q yaltiroq shisha, hamma qavatda bir xil. Ostidagi nur qavat rangida (`floor-<qavat>-glow`).

tokens.name: btn-glass-text
tokens.usage: Kapsula tugma matni va ikonkasi (`btn-glass-bg` ustida 17:1).

tokens.name: floor-navigator-glow
tokens.usage: 1-qavat nuri: tugma osti, shisha orqasidagi rang dog'i. Matn emas.

tokens.name: floor-admission-glow

tokens.name: floor-sat-glow
tokens.usage: 3-qavat nuri. Matn emas.

tokens.name: floor-ielts-glow
tokens.usage: IELTS nuri: kapsula tugma osti, `.t-fon` dog'lari. Faqat bezak.

tokens.name: floor-eyuf-glow
tokens.usage: 5-qavat nuri: kapsula tugma osti, `.t-fon` dog'lari. Faqat bezak.

tokens.name: floor-navigator-500
tokens.usage: 1-qavat Navigator belgi rangi (YANGI, laym; oldin moviy #19d3e6). Lift, bino, chip. Faqat `nav-stage` kabi qora sirtda yoki qora chegarali fill sifatida: yorug' fonda 1.5:1.

tokens.name: floor-admission-500
tokens.usage: 2-qavat Top Admission belgi rangi (YANGI 2026-11-17, to'q sariq; oldin sariq #ffc21f). Lift, bino, nur. Qora matn bilan fill (6.3:1). `floor-ielts-500` qizili bilan yaqin (1.2:1): IELTS mini-DS'ida hal qilinadi.

tokens.name: floor-sat-500
tokens.usage: 3-qavat SAT prep belgi rangi. Bezak va belgi, matn emas.

tokens.name: floor-ielts-500
tokens.usage: 4-qavat belgi rangi (2026-11-17 dan elektr ko'k, muallif tanlovi; oldin qizil #EF4841). Lift nuqtasi, bino, chip va bezakda; matn emas. SAT ko'ki floor-sat-500 bilan yaqin (1.57): ikki qavatni ajratish hal qilinmagan, Lift'da rang doim qavat raqami bilan keladi.

tokens.name: floor-eyuf-500
tokens.usage: 5-qavat EYUF belgi rangi (2026-11-18 dan zumrad; oldin yashil #3BD879, Navigator laymi bilan 1.07 edi, endi 2.54 va boshqa ton). Lift, bino, chip, bezak. Matn emas: yorug' `bg` ustida 4.0:1, qorong'i 4.4:1 (ikonka va chiziq uchun yetadi).

tokens.name: floor-admission-text
tokens.usage: 2-qavat rangidagi matn `bg`/`surface` ustida (yorug' 5.1:1, qorong'i 9:1).

tokens.name: floor-sat-text
tokens.usage: 3-qavat rangidagi matn `bg`/`surface` ustida.

tokens.name: floor-ielts-text
tokens.usage: Poydevor sahifalarida IELTS rangidagi matn: `surface` ustida yorug' 8.1:1, qorong'i 8.6:1.

tokens.name: floor-eyuf-text
tokens.usage: Poydevor sahifalarida EYUF rangidagi matn: yorug' `bg` 5.4:1, `surface` 5.9:1; qorong'i `bg` 11.0:1, `surface` 10.2:1.

tokens.name: nav-stage

tokens.name: nav-stage-raised
tokens.usage: Qora sahna ichidagi ko'tarilgan blok: ramkali karta, mono panel.

tokens.name: nav-paper
tokens.usage: Navigator oq bloki, ikkala mavzuda bir xil. Qora sahna bilan navbatma-navbat keladi.

tokens.name: nav-cream

tokens.usage: Navigator urg'usi: joriy qadam tuguni, faol raqam, chip foni. Faqat `nav-stage` ustida (10:1) yoki `nav-stage` matni bilan fill.

tokens.name: nav-lime-text

tokens.name: nav-line-strong
tokens.usage: Yo'l chizig'i, kelgusi qadam tuguni, ramka burchaklari: ma'noli chiziq, `nav-bg` ustida 3:1 dan yuqori. Qorong'i qiymat sayt bilan moslashtirilgan (2026-11-24): oldingi #6e6e6e `nav-surface` (#303030) ustida 2.59:1 edi, 3:1 kerak; #828282 sirtda 3.43:1, `nav-bg` ustida 4.62:1 (tokens.css).

tokens.name: nav-line-on-stage

tokens.name: adm-line

tokens.name: sat-navy
tokens.usage: SAT navy sahnasi, ikkala mavzuda bir xil: kirish hero, plitkalar, pastki tab bar, qorong'i mavzuda sahifa foni. AutoHub pinidan o'lchangan (#061e36–#0a223c). Navigator `nav-stage` bilan yorqinlikda yaqin (1.03:1): farqi ko'k tus, shisha va ko'k nur.

tokens.name: sat-navy-raised
tokens.usage: Navy ustidagi tekis (shaffof emas) blok: shishasiz holat (`prefers-reduced-transparency`) va qorong'i `sat-surface`. Ustida `sat-on-navy` 13:1, `sat-on-navy-muted` 6.9:1.

tokens.name: sat-navy-high
tokens.usage: Navy ustidagi bosilgan holat foni (plitka `:active`). Ustida `sat-on-navy` 10.6:1, `sat-sky` 5.4:1.

tokens.name: sat-mist
tokens.usage: Yorug' mavzudagi SAT sahifa foni, sovuq oq. Seller dashboard pinidagi och-ko'k olinmagan.

tokens.name: sat-on-navy
tokens.usage: Navy sahna va navy shisha ustidagi asosiy matn va katta raqamlar (navy 15.7:1, nur dog'i ustidagi shisha 9.5:1 dan yuqori).

tokens.name: sat-on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Navy sahna va navy shisha ustidagi ikkinchi matn, tab yorlig'i: navy 8.3:1, shaffof navy shisha nur dog'i ustida ham 5:1, zich shishada 7:1.

tokens.name: sat-sky
tokens.usage: Navy ustidagi ko'k matn, ikonka va faol tab: navy 8:1, shaffof navy shisha 4.9:1 dan (nur dog'i ustida) yuqori, zich shishada 6.9:1. Faqat navy ustida.

tokens.name: sat-line-on-navy
tokens.usage: Navy sahna ustidagi ma'noli chegara: chip, maydon (navy 4.7:1, zich navy shisha 4:1).

tokens.name: sat-blue
tokens.usage: SAT belgi rangi: hover chegara, grafik chizig'i, Lift. Matn emas. Nur uchun poydevordagi `floor-sat-glow`.

tokens.name: sat-blue-fill
tokens.usage: Tanlangan holat foni: faol chip, tanlangan javob harfi, ko'rsatkich ikonka doirasi, ko'k kapsula tugma. Ustida `sat-on-blue-fill` 5.1:1. Yorug' shishadan 3.9–5:1 ajraladi; qorong'i zich shishada 2.9–3.1:1, shuning uchun holat yana so'z, belgi va `aria-pressed`/`aria-checked` bilan aytiladi.

tokens.name: sat-on-blue-fill
tokens.usage: `sat-blue-fill` ustidagi matn va ikonka (5.1:1).

tokens.name: sat-bg
tokens.usage: 3-qavat sahifa foni (`.sat.t-fon`): yorug'da `sat-mist`, qorong'ida navy. Ostida poydevorning `floor-sat-glow` nur dog'lari.

tokens.name: sat-surface
tokens.usage: Shishasiz (tekis) sirt: `prefers-reduced-transparency` va backdrop-filter yo'q brauzer.

tokens.name: sat-glass

tokens.name: sat-glass-strong
tokens.usage: SAT zich shishasi (`.sat-shisha--zich`): savol, test, ro'yxat, forma, qidiruv va chip. Matn kontrasti shu sirtda hisoblangan (yorug' ≈#f1f6ff, qorong'i ≈#0e294a).

tokens.name: sat-glass-navy-border

tokens.name: sat-text
